{{Top|leg}}
{{Quote|Of course, we'll rip out those wimpy blaster cannons and put something with a bit more punch in the turrets, sling a concussion missile system beneath the cockpit, then rig it all together with one of these sleek new combat computers we lifted out of the Sienar Fleet Systems research tower right here on Byblos.|[[Bolabo Hujaan]], preparing to modify the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']]|<ref name="All the Extras">{{WEGCite|story=All the Extras|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>}}
A '''combat computer''' was a specialized [[Computer/Legends|computer]] designed to expediate [[Starship/Legends|starship]] combat systems. Combat computers worked in tandem with [[Servomotor/Legends|turret servos]], making minute adjustments to improve the fire accuracy of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
